papers.title: A Survey of Robotic Navigation and Manipulation with Physics Simulators in the Era of Embodied AI
papers.summary: Navigation and manipulation are core capabilities in Embodied AI, but training agents to perform them directly in the real world is costly, time-consuming, and unsafe. Therefore, sim-to-real transfer has emerged as a key approach, yet the sim-to-real gap persists. This survey examines how physics simulators address this gap by analyzing properties that have received limited attention in prior surveys. papers.title: Schatting en tracking van de 6D-pose van objecten voor robotwaarneming
papers.summary: Estimating the 6D pose of objects, comprising both 3D position and orientation, is a key requirement for many robotic applications. It enables robots to perceive and interact intelligently with the physical environment, supporting tasks in human-robot collaboration, logistics automation, and industrial operations. In human-robot collaborative assembly settings, accurate and continuous 6D pose tracking of product parts is essential for precise grasping and placement. papers.title: QERRA-v2 Classical: Three-Layer Deterministic Safety & Ethical Execution Guard for Autonomous Robotics
papers.summary: QERRA-v2 Classical is an open-source, experimental three-layer execution guard and research middleware for autonomous robots and AI systems. Built upon the SEMEV-12 framework, the QERRA-HSR physical safety companion, and the QERRA-THRIVE value-ranking architecture, it investigates explainable, deterministic alternatives to black-box neural networks. papers.summary: BACKGROUND: Robotic-assisted technologies and evolving implant designs have been introduced in unicompartmental knee arthroplasty (UKA) to improve the accuracy and reproducibility of component positioning. papers.summary: Abstract Automated harvesting is pivotal to smart agriculture, yet precisely localizing picking points in complex orchard environments remains a key challenge for robotic harvesting systems. papers.summary: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate and compare learning-curve assessment in laparoscopic and robotic colorectal surgery and to develop a standardized framework for future learning-curve reporting. papers.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Design for Enhanced Performance and Energy Efficiency in Computer Architecture
papers.summary: This research journal discusses how Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) can enhance computer architecture design by addressing challenges in performance and energy efficiency. Traditional methods rely on expert intuition and exhaustive simulations, which are limited when exploring vast design spaces. AI introduces three main approaches: supervised learning and graph neural networks for early prediction of performance and power metrics, reinforcement learning for automated design space exploration, and runtime adaptation through learned controllers and predictors. papers.summary: Software issue resolution task aims to address real-world issues in software repositories based on natural language descriptions provided by users, representing a key aspect of software maintenance. With the rapid development of large language models (LLMs) in reasoning and generative capabilities, LLM-based approaches have made significant progress in automated software issue resolution. papers.title: Secure Recommender Systems: A Co-evolutionary Survey of Vulnerabilities, Attacks, and Defenses
papers.summary: Recommender systems (RS) increasingly mediate what users see, buy, and believe, making them attractive targets for malicious manipulation. papers.title: Robot-assisted total hip arthroplasty: does improved precision translate into better clinical outcomes? A systematic review
papers.summary: PURPOSE: Robot-assisted total hip arthroplasty (R-THA) is being adopted progressively because of its potential to improve implant positioning and restore hip biomechanics more accurately than conventional techniques. However, whether these technical advantages translate into meaningful clinical benefits remains uncertain. This systematic review compared robot-assisted and conventional THA regarding implant positioning, restoration of hip biomechanics, functional outcomes, and complications.
